name: Commsor
description: Commsor is a go-to-network platform for mapping business relationships, finding warm paths into target accounts, coordinating introductions and referrals, and activating network signals for revenue teams.
agentUseSummary: Commsor cannot be connected to Relay agents because Commsor publishes no supported account API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key integration, or remote MCP service for public third-party applications.

blocked.label: Connect a Commsor account
blocked.description: Commsor does not publish a supported OAuth, API-key, or remote MCP connection contract for public third-party applications.

blocked.label: Use Commsor account data
blocked.description: Commsor does not publish the authentication method, endpoints, schemas, permissions, or rate limits needed to access a customer's network and referral data through a supported account API.

blocked.label: Run Commsor agent actions
blocked.description: Relay Console cannot treat Commsor's user-facing LinkedIn and CRM integrations as a public Commsor account API or reverse engineer its private application interface.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Commsor publishes a supported distributable account API, delegated OAuth contract, or remote MCP service.

runtimeSupport.description: No documented public Commsor account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No documented public Commsor account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Commsor publishes a live product, knowledge base, LinkedIn connection guidance, and user-facing integrations but no public developer program, account API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key scheme, or remote MCP service. Its terms prohibit reverse engineering its software.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider Commsor only if the provider publishes or grants Relay Console a supported distributable integration contract with current documentation and credentials.

evidence.supports: Commsor describes its current product as a platform for mapping relationships, surfacing warm paths, automating B2B referrals, and activating network signals.
Commsor's official knowledge base documents customer product use but exposes no developer or public account-API contract.
Commsor's official help center documents user-facing account settings, LinkedIn connection, and Intro Boards without publishing third-party authorization or API documentation.
Commsor's terms prohibit attempting to decompile or reverse engineer software contained on its website.
Commsor's official status page confirms that its customer application is active; the blocker is the absence of a public third-party account contract, not product discontinuation.
